content.text:
Based on keyword searches of Delta's earnings press releases, Delta's guidance appears to cover operating margin, earnings per share, total revenue, capacity, CASM-Ex (unit cost), fuel price and free cash flow. I could only search the releases, not read them, so I couldn't see the outlook tables themselves. That means I can't confirm the exact guided line items, any of the guidance numbers, or which metrics are quarterly versus full-year.

**What the searches showed (earnings releases, Jan 2024 – Apr 2025):**

- **Terms in all six quarterly releases:** "Operating margin", "Earnings per share", "Total revenue", "Free cash flow", "Fuel price", "Capacity" and "CASM-Ex" each matched every release, in searches that also included the words "guidance" and "quarter".
- **Terms in only two releases:** "Gross leverage", "Effective tax rate" and "Non-operating" matched only the October 2024 and January 2025 releases. These may be full-year or longer-term targets rather than quarterly ones, but that's an inference.
- **Labels I couldn't confirm:** An exact-phrase search for "Total revenue compared to" together with "Fuel price per gallon" found nothing, so the precise wording of Delta's guidance rows is unconfirmed.

A word turning up in a release doesn't prove it's a guided metric, because these terms also appear in the results tables. To confirm the list and get the actual numbers, the next step is to open the "Guidance" section of the April 9, 2025 release (link below). Without reading it, I also can't say whether the full-year outlook in that release was kept, changed or withdrawn.

**Sources** (Delta Air Lines 8-Ks, Exhibit 99.1 earnings releases)
- 8-K, filed 2025-04-09, accession 0001683168-25-002353 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/27904/000168316825002353/delta_ex9901.htm)

- 8-K, filed 2024-07-11, accession 0001683168-24-004743
- 8-K, filed 2024-04-10, accession 0001683168-24-002249
- 8-K, filed 2024-01-12, accession 0001683168-24-000244
